summary: > “Koumei, what shall be my fate? Adrift in the river of destiny, I will flow with you. Gamble with my life, for I choose to roll the dice. Cast out evil, though I see it is a part of me. To make this choice is my only choice. Koumei, what shall be my fate?”
> Koumei's Shrine is an Ostron altar dedicated to the Warframe Koumei. Placed at the entrance of Cetus, the shrine serves as a gateway to the Shrine Defense mission.
